mutations.before: held?.briefId === state.briefId ? held : { briefId: state.briefId, assets: [] }
mutations.because: The whole fix is the scope check in the failure branch: without it, a failed refetch discards the listing an earlier successful fetch resolved for this campaign, and every tile that read a resolved file name drops to "Unavailable asset" though nothing about it changed. With the ternary reduced to the empty-listing branch the new test's assertion `screen.getByText("alpha.png")` after the failed refetch finds nothing and fails.
command: a failed listing refetch keeps the names an earlier listing resolved
